verdict.rationale: Exemption and resale certificate management is a fair question for a sales tax automation product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions collecting, validating, storing, tracking expiry of, or automatically applying customer exemption or resale certificates. Product tax codes (category-level exemptions) and VAT number validation are adjacent features and are not certificate management.

support.subject: As an ops user, exemption and resale certificates are managed end to end — collected from customers, validated, stored with expiry tracking, and applied automatically at calculation time
